providers.name: Galaxy, procedurally generated by scripts/generate-procedural-textures.mjs (no third-party material)

review.note: Checked live (2026-08-26): no controlled global mosaic published by USGS. Procedural texture: one of the oldest, least-resurfaced Uranian moon surfaces, with craters up to ~200 km bearing central peaks — rendered as dense cratering with two large central-peak basins.
